GUIDE.TITLE: How to use Bus-Nakay?
GUIDE.INTRO: Discover in a few steps how to easily find your bus, your route, and the places you need.

ROUTE.TITLE: Find a bus between two stops
ROUTE.SUBTITLE: From your departure point to your destination
ROUTE.DESCRIPTION: Would you like to know which bus to take from one stop to another? Bus-Nakay can help you!
ROUTE.STEP_5: Select a bus to view its route and different stops, as well as its route displayed on the map.
ROUTE.TIP: use this feature when you know your departure stop and arrival stop.

PLACE.TITLE: Find a bus from a location
PLACE.SUBTITLE: Don't know which stop to use?
PLACE.DESCRIPTION: You know your destination, but you don't know which stop or bus to use? No problem!
PLACE.GPS_WARNING: Make sure the application is allowed to access your location and that your GPS is enabled.
PLACE.TIP: this method is particularly useful when you know the name of a neighborhood, place, or popular location, but not the name of the bus stop.

STOP.TITLE: Search for a place
STOP.SUBTITLE: Quickly find the location of a place in Mahajanga on the map
STOP.DESCRIPTION: Would you simply like to find a place in Mahajanga and see its location on the map? Here's how:
STOP.STEP_3: Enter the keywords corresponding to the place you want to search for.
STOP.STEP_5: Click the Show button to display the place on the map.
STOP.TIP: the green badge displayed on each result indicates the distance between the place and your current location.

TIPS.TITLE: A few tips
TIPS.SUBTITLE: To use Bus-Nakay more effectively
TIPS.TIP_1: Enable your location when using Bus-Nakay to take full advantage of the features based on your position.
TIPS.TIP_2: Make sure that the bus you take matches the one indicated in the application.
TIPS.TIP_3: Don't forget to check in the application which stop you need to get off at.
TIPS.TIP_4: Use the map view to better follow your route and find your way throughout your journey.
TIPS.CONCLUSION: With Bus-Nakay, find your route easily and travel with greater peace of mind.
